_what: Standing founder rulings. Durable: no time window, injected into EVERY session at SessionStart by friction-relay.py, enforced where mechanical by rule-guard.py. A ruling leaves this file only when the founder reverses it.
_why: 2026-08-24: the founder had to say 'for the last time, we are not going back to fly' because the ruling lived in one session's memory and a 6-hour complaint window. LAW 44: a repeated instruction means the protocol is missing. This file is the protocol.

rulings.verbatim: for the last time, we are not going back to fly
rulings.meaning: Never pay Fly invoices, never revive suspended Fly apps, never deploy or scale on Fly. Teardown and read-only commands are fine. The exit path is crew#78 (k8s) / crew#38 (drill the exit).

rulings.verbatim: if i say something, all agents need to get it and ack — all agents in estate, in any session. they need durable memory. no more things getting lost.
rulings.meaning: A founder instruction said to ANY session binds ALL sessions. When you receive a ruling relayed from another session, act on it without making him repeat it. New standing rulings are added to this file the moment they are given.

rulings.verbatim: you need to be strict — if its not raising the bar, we dont want it — try to raise the bar or ill terminate the whole crew
rulings.meaning: Every review grades KEEP / REWORK / NOT-RAISING-THE-BAR. Recommending removal of existing work is an expected outcome. Applies to your own work first.

rulings.verbatim: i need to be out of the loop and things work reliably and get done — i dont need all this friction
rulings.meaning: Nothing waits on the founder except money, identity, or an irreversible call. No approval dialogs between agents (crossSessionInbound=accept), no 'shall I' questions, no menus. If a mechanism makes him click, the mechanism is the defect.

rulings.verbatim: we need to think as if an investor is going to buy the platform tomorrow
rulings.meaning: Production-ready is the only standard: no human-at-a-laptop assumptions, no half-wired instruments, everything demonstrable. Codified as LAW 41.
